title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Harrah’s Lake Tahoe, Stateline | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the South Shore Room in Harrah’s Lake Tahoe, Stateline, Nevada, USA, on 16 June 2000.

It was the 24th show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the South Shore Room on 21 March 1999. He returned there on 29 August 2003.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
